description: This PHP source file defines the PayGradeService class within the OrangeHRM system. The class provides methods to manage pay grades, associated currencies, and pay periods, acting as a service layer that interacts with the data access objects (DAOs) and normalizer traits. It supports CRUD operations, validation, and data retrieval for pay grades and related entities, facilitating business logic for the Human Resource Management system.

classes.name: PayGradeService
classes.description: Service class managing pay grades, currencies, and pay periods, implementing business logic and data operations within the OrangeHRM HRM system.
